question: Where can I find a university inside a 120 kilometers radius toward the east of Maryvale Baseball Park, Phoenix, AZ?
sql: WITH maryvale_park AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Maryvale Baseball Park%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, maryvale_park AS mp WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, mp.geometry::geography, 120000) -- within 120 km radius AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geometry)) > ST_X(ST_Centroid(mp.geometry)) -- to the east (longitude check) ;
